name: Cerebellar cortex layer formation and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine cerebellar granule, Purkinje and Bergmann glial layer formation with locomotion, proprioception and motor learning, which separates the theme from amygdala/grooming behaviour, brainstem/hindbrain and forebrain development, and glycinergic transmission confusables.

core: Mitotic spindle assembly and checkpoint control
name: Mitotic spindle assembly, kinetochore attachment and checkpoint control
rationale: All members concern building and monitoring the mitotic spindle (MAD2 checkpoint, kinetochore-microtubule attachment, midzone assembly, elongation), unlike confusables centred on cytokinesis, sister chromatid cohesion or NEK/AURKA mitotic entry.

name: Cell-surface receptor internalization toward lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members describe clathrin cargo recognition, receptor internalization, reduced recycling and lysosomal targeting that clear receptors from the cell surface, whereas confusables are about cholesterol homeostasis, LXR/SREBP control and LDL clearance.

name: Glomerular mesangial and endothelial development
rationale: All members concern development of glomerular mesangium, mesangial cells and glomerular vasculature/endothelium, while confusables cover metanephric mesenchyme, tubules and kidney growth control.

qualifier: P450 oxidation and conjugation of drugs and plant compounds
name: Xenobiotic and plant-compound biotransformation by P450 oxidation and conjugation
rationale: Members span drug and phytochemical metabolism (paracetamol, aromatic amines, alkaloids, terpenoids, phenylpropanoids) via CYP2E1/CYP1A2 oxidation and sulfonation, methylation and acetylation, distinguishing it from FMO, thiopurine/TPMT and steroid/cytochrome confusables.

name: Regulation of inflammatory cytokine output and TGF-beta1 production
rationale: Members concern control of cytokine output (TNF/IL-23 lymphocyte effectors, macrophage cytokine production, TGF-beta1 production, IL-37 and autocrine signalling), unlike confusables built on IL-10/IL-27/IL-35 signalling, IL-6-family receptors or myeloid NF-kB activation.

name: MicroRNA biogenesis and silencing by deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA silencing through poly(A) shortening, P-body assembly and mRNA decay, distinguishing them from siRNA, miRNA-turnover and translation-repression confusables.

Members mix uncharacterised transcription-factor motif sets, ER membrane protein and extracellular-region gene sets, endothelial-matrix adhesion and responses to heparin and glycoprotein, with no biological process true of all of them.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites, hindbrain and limbs
name: Hox-driven axial patterning of somites, hindbrain and limbs
rationale: Members are Hox gene clusters, somitogenesis, rhombomere/hindbrain, neural plate and limb/digit/joint patterning, separating the theme from axial mesoderm/floor-plate/spinal cord and craniofacial/pharyngeal confusables.

name: Synaptic transmission enhancement, locomotor exploration and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members pair enhanced glutamatergic/GABAergic neuron-neuron transmission and NCAM1 interactions with locomotor, exploratory and prepulse-inhibition behaviour, unlike confusables centred on amygdala/grooming, dendritic spine maintenance or AMPA receptor clustering.

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance, extension and collateral sprouting
rationale: Members centre on netrin-1 attraction/repulsion signalling, axon extension and collateral sprouting including monoaminergic axon guidance, distinguishing them from ephrin/L1, Sema3A and SLIT-ROBO commissural guidance confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth, adaptation and stress survival
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell growth, adaptation, stress hypertrophy, sarcomere organisation, regeneration and apoptosis, unlike confusables on calcineurin-NFAT signalling, contraction force or cardiomyocyte proliferation.

qualifier: SARS replicase and host translation control
name: SARS coronavirus replicase, genome replication and host translation subversion
rationale: All members concern SARS-CoV-1/2 replicase translation and maturation, genome replication, RNA capping and IFIT evasion and host translation modulation, distinguishing them from influenza and RSV replication confusables.

name: P450 omega-hydroxylation and epoxidation of eicosanoids and fatty acids
rationale: Members describe P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase routes making HETEs and EETs and catabolising leukotriene B4, unlike leukotriene synthesis, cyclooxygenase, lipoxygenase and skin-barrier fatty acid confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II initiation, promoter escape and co-transcriptional capping
rationale: Members, host and HIV versions alike, cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter opening and escape, CTD phosphorylation and capping, whereas confusables cover elongation, pausing and Tat-dependent HIV elongation.

name: Mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT-III resealing and abscission
rationale: Members cover nuclear lamina and membrane disassembly, envelope reformation and ESCRT-III sealing, nuclear pore and envelope positioning and midbody abscission, unlike SUMOylation, cleavage furrow and chromosome condensation confusables.

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching with suppressed proliferation and migration
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle dedifferentiation and phenotypic switching while negatively regulating its differentiation, proliferation and migration, unlike confusables with positive proliferation/migration, endothelial activation or smooth muscle development.

name: Pulmonary surfactant metabolism and surfactant dysfunction disorders
rationale: All members concern surfactant metabolism and homeostasis and the inherited SFTP, ABCA3 and CSF2R defects that disrupt it, distinguishing them from erythrocyte gas transport, phospholipid scrambling and lung epithelial development confusables.

qualifier: OXPHOS, ATP synthesis and ROS output
name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration, ATP synthesis and ROS output
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis, PGC-1alpha activation and ROS-linked stress responses, unlike confusables centred on peroxide-, hypoxia- and ferroptosis-induced cell death.

core: RNA virus replication in host cells
qualifier: influenza, RSV and coronavirus RNP cycles
name: Respiratory RNA virus replication, RNP trafficking and host evasion
rationale: Members cover influenza vRNP synthesis and nuclear import/export, RSV genome replication and assembly, SARS-CoV replication and evasion of PKR/IFIT, distinguishing them from SARS-only replicase themes and from HIV/HCMV DNA-virus confusables.

name: Dendritic spine maintenance and LTP suppression in amyloid-beta response
rationale: Members concern maintenance of neuron projections, dendritic spines and postsynaptic membrane together with inhibition of LTP and the amyloid-beta response, unlike confusables promoting plasticity, reelin signalling or synaptic transmission.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling and secretion
rationale: Members cover Rab-GAP and ARF signalling governing endosome organisation, receptor recycling, endocytosis, Golgi localisation and constitutive secretion, unlike neuronal receptor trafficking, membrane tubulation and Golgi-lysosome transport confusables.

name: Telomere C-strand fill-in synthesis and end protection
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand initiation, polymerase switching and flap removal plus telomere packaging, recombination inhibition and telomerase restraint, unlike telomerase extension, ALT/recombination and capping-regulation confusables.

name: Proteasomal protein turnover regulation, degron pathways and K48 ubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal catabolism and protein destabilisation via N-end and C-end degrons, K48 and autoubiquitination and UCH deubiquitinases, distinguishing them from atypical ubiquitin chain, ribosome quality control and ERAD/misfolded-protein confusables.

qualifier: type II transporters and hypophosphatemic disorders
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport and hypophosphatemic disorders
rationale: All members concern type II Na+/Pi cotransporters (SLC34A1/A3) and their hypophosphatemic diseases, unlike FGF23-Klotho, parathyroid hormone, bone mineralization and other phosphate-transporter confusables.
